title: Chapter 104 Wood Fairyland
content:
Chapter 104 Wood Fairyland

Nineteen years old.

That's not really young.

However, Lu Daosheng was still a little furious.

With a wave of his hand, Fan Yingying disappeared immediately.

Looking at Ah Wei, who was ashamed and lowered his head tightly, Lu Daosheng didn't care about anything. He pointed at Ah Wei's nose and said angrily: "Ah Wei, don't you feel guilty?!"

This extremely childish woman was actually able to do it.

It's too much.

Hearing this, Ah Wei lowered his head and didn't say anything.

Seeing Ah Wei like this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and said: "Ah Wei, I naturally don't object to you two being together. Of course, I can't control this matter, but..."

Lu Daosheng changed the subject and said coldly: "I don't want you to be a person who doesn't take feelings seriously."

Of course, these words Lu Daosheng just reminded Ah Wei.

He could see that Ah Wei was serious this time.

That Fan Yingying is also a good girl.

If the two of them were together, they would be a good match.

The important thing is that this is the first time that Ah Wei has had this kind of reaction to a woman.

Lu Daosheng has always thought that Ah Wei didn't understand these things. It turns out that he just hasn't met the right person.

When Ah Wei heard what Lu Daosheng said, his eyes were slightly red.

"Lord City Lord, I will definitely treat Yingying well."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, and chose to forgive Ah Wei for tricking Fan Yingying into calling him husband.

Well, in fact, he was just envious.

But he would never say this.

He waved to Ah Wei, "Ah Wei, you go down first."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

After Ah Wei left, Fan Yingying suddenly appeared in the field.

Fan Yingying, who hadn't figured out what happened, looked at Lu Daosheng who was looking at her seriously, and quickly lowered her head.

"Yingying, what do you think of Ah Wei?"

"Ah?"

Fan Yingying was a little stunned.

Lu Daosheng asked again: "I say, what do you think of A Wei? What kind of person is he?"

Hearing this, Fan Yingying was silent for a moment, and slowly said: "Brother is a very good person. He saved me, took me in, and treated me very well."

"I think he is a very gentle person."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng laughed immediately.

This is the first time he heard someone describe A Wei as gentle.

Lu Daosheng was very relieved.

It seems that this matter is considered to be a success.

......

Finally, A Wei took Yingying away from the City Lord's Mansion with a smile on his face.

Everyone in the City Lord's Mansion was shocked.

They had never seen A Wei so happy.

And in the deserted city, in a noodle shop.

Two people brought a young man to the noodle shop and walked to the innermost table.

"Sir, the person is here."

An Xing sipped his noodles and looked up at the young man.

It was the person who reported the casino before.

"Your subordinate greets you, sir."

Seeing An Xing, the young man bowed directly.

An Xing waved his hand, "You did a good job on this matter. You will stay here to work in the future."

Hearing this, he was immediately excited.

This is simply a promotion of three levels!

The lord in front of him has such a high status in the root organization.

Yes, he was sent by An Xing to deliberately tell Huang Wei about the casino incident.

A casino has been discovered by the root members since the moment it was built.

But An Xing did not react at all, just sent someone to watch it.

He did not want to get involved in such things.

It was just right to let A Wei do that kind of thing.

After sending a few people away, An Xing wiped his mouth and said, "Boss, pay the bill."

"Sir, this bowl of noodles is a gift from me."

At this time, the boss walked to An Xing and said with a smile.

Hearing this, An Xing was a little stunned and looked at the noodle shop owner suspiciously.

Sensing An Xing's gaze, the boss coughed lightly and then revealed the special mark on his wrist.

Seeing this, An Xing's mouth twitched slightly.

This is actually a member of the Root Organization.

Good guy, it turns out that this noodle shop is opened by his family.

After all, there are so many people in the Root Organization, and he can't recognize them all.

After looking at the boss meaningfully, An Xing got up and left directly.

"Sir, take care."

After An Xing left, the noodle shop owner wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.

In fact, he didn't recognize An Xing, but he just received an order from his immediate boss. The person in front of him is a big shot in the organization, and he tried his best to please him.

Looking at the direction where An Xing left, the boss was silent.

And at this moment, another voice sounded from the noodle shop.

"Boss, check out."

"Forty God Crystals."

"Fuck, why is it doubled, isn't it twenty-one bowls?"

"Is it your business?"

.........

At the same time, the Wood Immortal Realm.

A group of powerful men with terrifying auras were constantly tearing through the void and moving forward in one direction.

The leader was the Holy Lord of the Immortal Holy Land, Gongsun Sheng.

At this moment, Gongsun Sheng had a gloomy expression, and murderous intent surged in his eyes.

At this moment, an illusory barrier appeared in front of everyone, blocking their way.

In front of them was the Land of Nothingness.

Through the Land of Nothingness, you can go to the lower world.

However, this place has the most terrifying rule power in the entire Wood Immortal Realm.

"Holy Lord, should we make a long-term plan?"

At this time, a powerful man from the Holy Land stepped forward and hesitated.

Hearing this, Gongsun Sheng's face was gloomy, "Why would I let the other party escape from the lower world if I kill my granddaughter? Just an ant, I can let the other party die thousands of times!"

The next moment, Gongsun Sheng took out a hazy aura.

Seeing this scene, the powerful people in the holy land around him were shocked.

Fairy spirit!

This is the origin of their fairy holy land.

Although it's just a little bit, it's extremely precious.

In order to avenge his granddaughter, the Holy Lord even took out such a treasure.

It can be said that if you use a little, you can use a little less.

"go."

Gongsun Sheng spoke.

Then the immortal spirit energy poured directly into the land of nothingness.

Buzz —

In just a moment, the entire land of nothingness began to tremble slightly.

The next moment, a passage that could only accommodate one person appeared in front of Gongsun Sheng.

"What! A fairy spirit can only be used to open this little bit?!"

Gongsun Sheng looked at the passage in front of him, his face looking ugly.

Too dark!

But he had no choice but to turn around and said, "You are here to wait for a moment."

Then Gongsun Sheng rushed in directly.

As he had just entered, the passage disappeared in an instant.

At this moment, a sharp eyes suddenly opened in the land of nothingness.

Rumble!

Through layers of voids, Gongsun Sheng finally reached the end.

"Ahhhh! Damn it, why is this happening?!"

Gongsun Sheng looked at the empty barrier in front of him, his face a little ferocious, and he still couldn't enter the lower realm.

Although he had guessed that this would happen, he still felt a little lucky in his heart.

At this moment, the powerful repulsion force in front of him made him unable to go any further.

But in a flash, he returned to his calm again.

"It's really a good deal to kill you."

Gongsun Sheng gritted his teeth.

The body cannot enter the lower realm, but its power is OK.

With your own strength, you can kill an ant in the lower realm and do it in the blink of an eye.

Unfortunately, I can't go to the lower realm to do it myself.

Immediately, Gongsun Sheng closed his eyes and felt the mark left by Gongsun Yao's fall.

After a moment, Gongsun Sheng suddenly opened his eyes and looked at a place below.

An attack containing terrifying power suddenly burst out from Gongsun Sheng's hand.

boom!

Accompanied by the slow fluctuation of the land of nothingness.

The power suddenly surged towards the lower realm.
